newsitem.title: UK: LME copper eases further in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper eases further in late trading.

text.p: Copper prices slid lower in late trading on Thursday following an already weak kerb close.
Three months London Metal Exchange (LME) copper was indicated at $2,320/$2,324 at 1800 GMT, compared to $2,340 at the end of the afternoon kerb.

"The close is disappointing and has formed a bearish outside day, confirmed by the technical indicators looking to cross down, which is suggestive of further selling pressure," brokers Rudolf Wolff said in a commentary.
Aluminium, which had crumbled under fund liquidation earlier in the day, was little changed at $1,607/$1,610, versus $1,609 at the kerb close.
Zinc was hovering around the $1,260 support level after ending the kerb at a sharply lower $1,259. The other metals were also little changed.
